title: Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe Quote Row
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe | Pinjin Xingtai Quote by DN
description: Pinjin straight delivery pipe is made in Xingtai with coupling ends. Diameter, wall and length are quoted after the pump model. No fixed DN table, no list price, no small-batch shipping. A marketplace DN125 or 20-piece MOQ is not this page.
secondaryKeywords: trailer pump delivery pipe no list price

relatedPaths.label: Concrete pump delivery pipe product page
Concrete pump hose vs steel pipe

answerBlock.what: Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe is a straight pipeline spare part manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Factory photos show red enamel pipes with reinforced coupling ends. Inner diameter, wall thickness and length are quoted after the pump model. This page does not publish a fixed DN table or a list price, and it is not sold in small batches.
answerBlock.who: Service teams replacing or extending the steel line on a listed Pinjin pump, in project quantity, after DN and length are confirmed.
factors: No published list price and no piece-count MOQ on the Pinjin page
Electric 20 prints 80 mm pipe; LZ-60 prints 100 / 125 mm — the pipe SKU still needs the model confirmed
A marketplace listing that prints DN100 / DN125 and a 20-piece minimum is not this table
The DN200 elbow and the rubber hose are separate SKUs

faqs.question: Does Pinjin print a list price or a fixed DN table for the straight delivery pipe?
faqs.answer: No. Diameter, wall and length are quoted after the pump model. The page does not publish a list price and does not sell small batches. Send the pump model, DN and length.

faqs.question: Is the marketplace 20-piece MOQ the Pinjin delivery-pipe minimum?
faqs.answer: No. A Made-in-China delivery-pipe listing shows price to be negotiated above 20 pieces, with DN100 / DN125 / custom and ST52 or 45Mn2. Those cells are not printed on the Pinjin pipe page.
